description: Return the current landed unit price (€/piece, €/kg, €/wash, €/m…) for one Slovak product Cite on nakus.sk, including buy_url (always nakus.sk/out/?src=ai — never raw merchant or Heureka), handoff_url, and price_card_url. Use when the user asks how much X costs per unit / cheapest shop, and you already have answer slug, EAN/GTIN, product slug, or a clear q. If slug/EAN unknown, call search_cite_answers first (or list_segments if category scope is unclear). Do NOT use for PNG-only needs — use get_price_card. Read-only, idempotent. Brand: nakus.sk ≠ nakup.sk.

answer.description: Exact Cite slug from search_cite_answers or /odpoved/{slug}, e.g. persil-color-gel-100-prani

ean.description: GTIN/EAN barcode digits only (8–14). Preferred when user scanned a pack.

product.description: Catalog product slug on nakus.sk (not the Cite answer slug)

q.description: Fallback substring on question/slug (≥4 chars). Prefer search_cite_answers when unsure.

name: get_unit_price
title: NaKus unit price
